genius.headline: Zouhair Talbi runs the fastest New York City Marathon time ever by a U.S. runner
genius.summary: American distance runner Zouhair Talbi finished sixth in the men's race at the New York City Marathon on Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026. According to the Associated Press, his time was the fastest ever run by a U.S. runner in the event. Sweden's Andreas Almgren won the men's race in his marathon debut.

quote.text: American Zouhair Talbi finished sixth on Sunday and ran the fastest time ever by a U.S. runner in the event.

facepalm.headline: Chicago elections board says a coding error caused Election Day ballot shortages at some precincts
facepalm.summary: The Chicago Board of Elections said Wednesday that a coding error in the system it uses to calculate ballot quantities left some split precincts short of one ballot style and oversupplied with another during Tuesday's midterm election, leading to long lines. Every precinct got the correct total number of ballots, according to the board, which said the error was a first, added new validation checks and apologized to voters.

quote.text: Election officials blamed a coding error for causing ballot shortages at several Chicago precincts on Tuesday, forcing people to wait in long lines for touchscreen voting machines.
